subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — Finex pilot (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing & token economics — Finex pilot (recap + ask)

Hi Ethan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Call highlights:
- Pilot scope: ingest + search + contextual generation for customer support (avg prompt 300 tokens, avg response 1,200 tokens).
- Expected volume: 40M tokens/month initially, ramp to ~150M tokens/month by month 6 if pilot succeeds.
- Success criteria: 90th perc latency < 600ms for generate flows; cost per 1M tokens <= target (see below).

Pricing & economics notes (items to confirm):
1) Token volumes above — please confirm whether 40M/month is a conservative baseline or a firm committed starting point.
2) Budget range: you mentioned a pilot budget in the $8k–$15k/month range — can you confirm an anchored monthly budget (or target $/1M tokens)?
3) Stakeholder alignment: who is the economic buyer and who will sign off with finance (we'll need to route the procurement/contract accordingly)?

Next steps I propose:
- We’ll send a short unit-econ table showing Redwood list price, recommended discount tiers, and a target $/1M tokens for the pilot. (Action: Aditya to draft).
- Please loop in your finance/CFO if you want us to prepare a formal quote/PO path.
- Confirm the volume baseline and any compliance requirements.

I’ve attached a one-page mutual action plan and a draft token pricing model for discussion.

Would you prefer a short follow-up call early next week to lock budget and econ buyer?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
--
Redwood Inference | https://redwoodinference.com
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan.brooks@finex.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kara Lim <kara.lim@finex.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — Finex pilot (recap + ask)

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- 40M tokens/mo is what product is comfortable committing to for the pilot (conservative). If we see the expected reduction in support handle time, we'll aim for the 150M ramp.
- The $8k–$15k/month band I gave was a rough estimate; finance will want the $/1M number so they can model OPEX vs. in-house. Can you provide a target $/1M tokens and a 3-tier pricing (pilot, 3mo ramp, steady-state)?
- Please include a clear table showing Redwood list price, any proposed pilot discount, and the expected unit cost after any caching/batching assumptions.

Looping in Kara (Ops lead) for any compliance notes. I’ll also bring Raj (CFO) into the thread once you have a formal quote — Raj typically needs a clear per-unit benchmark to approve pilots.

Appreciate it,
Ethan
Product Lead, Finex.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — Finex pilot (recap + ask)

Perfect — thanks for confirming volume baseline, Ethan. Per your ask, we’ll put together a 3-tier table and include explicit assumptions (avg prompt/response tokens, expected cache hit, batching effects). 

Aditya / Neha — can you draft a short unit-econ sheet that includes:
- Redwood list $/1M tokens (for the model family we recommended)
- Suggested pilot discount and justification
- Modeled effective $/1M after assumed 30% prefix cache + 2x batching (conservative)
- Example monthly cost rows for 40M / 80M / 150M tokens

Aditya: please attach the .xlsx and a one-pager for Raj so he can see the line-item economics quickly. We’ll ask Ethan to introduce Raj once the quote is ready.

Ethan — is Raj the right CFO contact? If not, please confirm the economic buyer + finance approver and any PO/Procurement steps.

Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & token economics — Finex pilot (draft unit econ)

Marissa / Neha — attaching the draft pricing model and an executive one-pager (attached: token_pricing_model_v2.xlsx, Finex_pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key points: 

- Baseline list price (gpt-family equivalent): $1,800 / 1M tokens (list).
- Recommended pilot pricing: 60% of list → $720 / 1M tokens for the 40M pilot (limited-time pilot discount).
- Ramp pricing (40–150M): tiered discounts at 40–80M = 55% of list ($990 / 1M), 80–150M = 45% of list ($810 / 1M) *[note: these are illustrative; we can tighten]*
- Effective cost modeling w/ caching+batching (assumes 30% cache hit, effective tokens billed = tokens * 0.75):
  - 40M nominal -> 30M billed -> pilot price $720 => $21,600/mo
  - 150M nominal -> 112.5M billed -> ramp price $810 => $91,125/mo

Notes for finance/CFO: include a short line showing estimated infra/unit cost (GPU ops) and expected NRE credits for onboarding. Also flag that sustained volumes justify a dedicated capacity path (Redwood Dedicated) which lowers unit costs further.

I’ve left a cell for "target $/1M (customer goal)" — Marissa, Ethan: can you confirm the target $/1M that finance wants to see (so we can rework discounts to meet that anchor)?

-Aditya

Attachments: token_pricing_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), Finex_pilot_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

- Pilot price (recommended): $720 / 1M billed tokens (60% of list) -> est $21.6k/mo at 40M nominal
- Modeled effective $/1M after cache: shown in spreadsheet; we can tighten discount if you share a target $/1M for the CFO model.
- Next steps we need from Finex to formalize pilot: confirmation of budget owner (who will sign PO), finance approver email (for invoice/PO path), and a target approval date.

Raj — would you prefer we prepare a vendor quote (PDF) + DocuSign or a draft SOW + PO? We can do either depending on your procurement flow.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min sync if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
